texts.facts: In June 2003, the aggrieved had to leave her job due to her pregnancy and due to complete bed rest advised by the doctors and she had to remain in the matrimonial house. At this time, the mother in law of the aggrieved started emotionally and mentally torturing her. Instead of looking after the aggrieved during her pregnancy, the mother in law remained in the village for long intervals of time as a result of which the aggrieved in the advanced stage of pregnancy had to do the household work. Due to the constant workload during the advanced stage of pregnancy, the aggrieved was under constant stress and depression. Respondent no.1 remained a silent spectator on the mental and physical condition of the aggrieved which caused a great deal of mental tension in the mind of the aggrieved. Respondent no.1 did not have the time and money to spend on the treatment of the child. On 16.11.2007, family friends of aggrieved approached the respondents and tried to reconcile the differences but the respondents instead of reconciling the differences, came to the shop of father of the aggrieved on 17.11.2007 and used unparliamentary language. In June 2008, the respondent no. 1 sent summons of divorce petition.
